title: UDP_Simple reference protocol
current_gap: Field and time semantics, the quantities the simple layout drops, illegal-datagram rejection and original-SDK interop are unpinned; the manual's 112-byte SOut2SimulatorSimpleTime listing is a reference target, not an owned implementation.

atoms.name: reference_layout_identity
atoms.required: Pinned 112-byte SOut2SimulatorSimpleTime field map with offsets, types, units and endianness

atoms.name: time_semantics
atoms.required: The embedded time field's epoch, unit and monotonicity pinned against authoritative time

atoms.name: dropped_quantities
atoms.required: Explicit mapping of which UDP_Full quantities the simple layout drops and the consumer impact

atoms.name: malformed_rejection
atoms.required: Illegal-datagram rejection on this layout; owned readers prove the rejection pattern, not this protocol

atoms.name: sdk_interop_capture
atoms.required: Original-SDK interop with positive and negative datagrams captured

scope_rule: the simple layout is a distinct protocol, not UDP_Full with a mode label; its time field must not be confused with authoritative sim time

followups.blocked_by: Fixed manual/SDK source for the 112-byte field map and time field
Original SDK observation and capture tooling
